lines:
Responsibilities: Persists each saved workflow as exactly one schema-versioned canonical JSON graph edited by the canvas. It losslessly round-trips known and unknown node types, configuration fields, typed connections, transitions, positions, groups, comments, logical capability references, and dependency requirements.
Owned records/files: WorkflowId-addressed JSON documents plus a small atomic manifest of WorkflowId, schemaVersion, documentVersion, content hash, path, title/status metadata, and committed generation. There is no editable SQL or secondary graph body.
Keys and ordering: WorkflowId is stable; documentVersion is monotonic compare-and-swap state; contentHash identifies accepted bytes. Base-version conflicts never use timestamps or last-writer-wins. Active Chat snapshots refer to an accepted WorkflowId/version/hash and are not mutated by later saves.
Ports: exposes WorkflowDocumentRepository load/save/import-inert/export-lossless/watch operations only to the core Project, Workspace & Configuration Coordinator, plus read-only migration/backup maintenance to the storage coordinator.
Durability/migration/degraded behavior: atomic same-directory temp-write, file and directory fsync, rename, and manifest generation produce either the prior or new complete document. Schema migration is staged, checksum-verified, and unknown-field preserving. Malformed, missing-plugin, incompatible-node, or forward-schema documents remain intact and inspectable; unresolved requirements block execution rather than save/export. Recovery never fabricates lost nodes.
Retention/performance: bounded prior generations support conflict/recovery; default document limit is 16 MiB with explicit override. Parsing/validation is cancellable and off the UI path; manifest listing avoids full graph parsing, and watches are hash based.
Security/non-responsibilities: workflows contain only logical capability IDs and opaque credential references; credential values, lease material, executable plugin code, inherited approvals, and hidden reasoning are forbidden. This repository does not freeze Runs, resolve bindings, install/enable code, execute graphs, store run-local overlays, commit Git, or hold canonical Chat events.

data.name: Canonical Workflow JSON Document Repository
data.technology: Rust lossless schema-versioned JSON document repository
